title: Best gaming headset under ₹5,000 in India for GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox (2026)
h1: Best gaming headset under ₹5,000 for GTA 6
card: Four headsets under ₹5,000, wired and wireless, checked on Amazon.in.
description: Best gaming headsets under ₹5,000 in India for console play: Razer BlackShark V2 X, Logitech G431, HyperX Cloud Jet and PowerA LS10P, with compatibility read from Amazon.in listings.
answer: The Razer BlackShark V2 X is the safest all-round pick under ₹5,000 because its listing says multi-platform with a 3.5mm cable, which works on a PS5 or Xbox controller. If you want wireless, the HyperX Cloud Jet is the only one here and its title lists PS5.
intro: GTA 6 is a story game with a big city soundscape, so a comfortable headset with a clear mic matters more than a pile of surround-sound features. We kept this list to headsets that were priced under ₹5,000 on Amazon.in on the date shown, and we only claim a console works where the listing says so.

We have not tested these headsets and we show no star ratings. Each pick is based on the specifications on the product page. Prices move; the one beside each pick is the figure we read on the date shown.

picks.verdict: A 3.5mm wired headset with 50mm drivers and memory-foam cushions; the listing calls it multi-platform (PC/PS/Xbox/Switch/Mobile), so one headset covers a PS5 or an Xbox. Plug it into the controller and there is nothing to charge.

The only wireless pick: a 2.4GHz USB-A dongle plus Bluetooth 5.2, swivel-to-mute mic with sidetone. The listing names PS5, PC, Switch and Steam Deck; it does not name Xbox, so it is a PlayStation pick here. It sits right at the ₹5,000 limit, so check the price.
specs: PS5 / PC / Switch / Steam Deck per title

picks.role: Best if you also use a PC
picks.verdict: A wired headset with 50mm drivers, a flip-to-mute mic and DTS Headphone:X 2.0 on PC via Logitech G HUB. The listing says consoles connect with the 3.5mm cable (it names PS4 and Xbox One), so the surround software is PC-only.
specs: DTS Headphone:X 2.0 needs G HUB on PC

picks.verdict: A PlayStation-focused wired headset for PS5, PS4 and PC with 50mm drivers, a flip-to-mute mic, an on-ear volume dial and Tempest 3D Audio support per the listing. Lightweight and glasses-friendly. Not for Xbox per the listing.

p: Wired means no battery to forget and no lag from a wireless link; a 3.5mm headset plugs into the DualSense or Xbox controller. Wireless is nicer on the sofa, but you must keep it charged and it needs a USB port on the console for the dongle. Under ₹5,000 the choice is limited to one wireless model in our data, which is why the builder lets you filter for it.
If you want more wireless choice, the next step up in our data is the Logitech G535 and Sony INZONE H5, which cost more than ₹5,000.

sections.h2: What matters in a headset for a story game
p: Comfort for long sessions, a mic you can mute quickly, and positional audio you can trust. 7.1 surround on a wired stereo headset is software processing; on PS5 the console's own Tempest 3D Audio is the better first thing to try.

faq.q: Which gaming headset under ₹5,000 works with PS5?
faq.a: On Amazon.in listings we read: the Razer BlackShark V2 X (3.5mm, multi-platform), HyperX Cloud Jet (wireless, PS5 in the title), Logitech G431 (3.5mm for consoles) and PowerA LucidSound LS10P Gen 2 (PS5, PS4, PC).

faq.q: Will a 3.5mm headset work on a PS5 or Xbox controller?
faq.a: Yes, the DualSense and Xbox controllers both have a 3.5mm headset jack. Headsets that need USB, like many wireless ones, plug into the console instead.

faq.q: Is there a wireless headset under ₹5,000?
faq.a: In our data the HyperX Cloud Jet (2.4GHz dongle and Bluetooth) is the one wireless headset at or under ₹5,000 on the date shown. Its price is right at the limit, so check Amazon before buying.

faq.q: Do I need a headset for GTA 6 at all?
faq.a: No. GTA 6 plays through TV or monitor speakers, but a headset lets you play at night without disturbing others and gives better positional sound. It is optional.

faq.q: Why are there no star ratings on this page?
faq.a: We have not tested these products and we do not copy or invent reviews. Picks are based on the listed specifications and price.
